-- Vendor options for the drill filter (current customer).
SELECT br.vendor_code AS value,
       MAX(COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(cvpn.pretty_name::text), ''), pvn.pretty_name::text, br.vendor_code::text))::varchar AS label
FROM bill_management_v2.bill_records br
LEFT JOIN bill_management_v2.providers_pretty_name pvn ON pvn.code::text = br.vendor_code::text
LEFT JOIN bill_management_v2.customers_vendors_pretty_name cvpn ON cvpn.customer_id = br.customer_id AND cvpn.vendor_id = pvn.vendor_id
WHERE br.customer_id = {{ CustomerSelect.selectedOptionValue || 76013 }}
GROUP BY br.vendor_code
ORDER BY label;
